nodes.label: Warm Marketplace Redesign (V3 pulito minimal)
nodes.rationale: Replaces both the current editorial cream/terracotta tree and the pure white/zinc 2026-06-07 spec: warm brand marketplace with white base, warm ink foreground, logo palette as semantic accents (coral CTA, teal trust, olive free/success, amber sponsored), Plus Jakarta Sans for all product UI and Fraunces only in two brand moments (home hero H1, final CTA banner); photo-first because 'the photo is the conversion' in adoption marketplaces.

nodes.label: Brand Semantic Color System (coral/teal/olive/amber OKLCH tokens)
nodes.rationale: Raw logo colors only as graphic accents at >=3:1 context contrast, never small text; amber only as soft surface with dark text; warmth comes from warm ink, photos and accents, never cream backgrounds; contrast AA everywhere including text over hero scrim.
